probe: Falsify r268's append-only deterministic-terminal-path pattern against two concurrent Chat writers for the same effect_id plus authority drift and unrelated authoritative-ref movement, without a central lock or same-run retry.
result: CONDITIONAL_SURVIVAL_ONLY: deterministic create-only terminal paths suppress duplicate committed records under concurrent writers if the path key commits to the frozen authority tuple and effect descriptor, but exact no-silent-loss safety is not unconditional. A stable-ref monotonic-retention invariant is necessary; if a terminal path may be deleted or removed by force-rewrite/reset, a later 404 cannot distinguish never-created from previously-created-then-erased using O(1) role-local active state alone.

model.deterministic_key: H(role || phase || root || task || frozen_manifest_blob || frozen_desired_blob || frozen_role_blob || effect_id || canonical_pre_effect_descriptor)
same_authority_same_effect_race: Both writers derive the same terminal path from the same frozen authority and effect descriptor.
Both use create-only semantics; the repository can expose at most one final path identity at that deterministic path, while the losing/ambiguous writer must not switch to overwrite semantics.

A writer without confirmed success performs one exact deterministic-path readback. A matching terminal record means the effect is terminalized; a mismatching record is a conflict; a 404 is unresolved rather than permission to recreate in-run.
authority_drift: A change to any frozen authority blob changes the deterministic key/path, so an old-authority terminal cannot satisfy a new-authority invocation.
Every terminal record embeds the frozen authority tuple and is valid evidence only for that tuple; later consumers compare the embedded tuple to their current frozen authority before acceptance.
unrelated_ref_movement: Unrelated additive movement is safe if every later state of the authoritative ref preserves the terminal path and blob.

A force-reset, rewrite, or delete that removes the terminal path creates a false-absence state. With only current-path lookup and O(1) active role-local state, that false 404 is observationally indistinguishable from true never-created absence.
minimal_retention_invariant: Use one stable authoritative repository ref for terminal lookup.
Once terminal path P appears, every later accepted state of that ref preserves exactly the same blob at P; no delete, overwrite, force-rewrite, or history reset may remove or alter P.
Terminal writes are create-only and keyed by frozen authority plus canonical effect identity.
Ambiguous write plus 404 remains unresolved across invocations; never recreate from that 404 in the same invocation.

If monotonic retention cannot be trusted or mechanically evidenced, exact duplicate/no-silent-loss safety requires a stronger retained anchor and therefore cannot be claimed from r268's minimal structure alone.

stronger_per_effect_anchor_or_hash_chain.status: next alternative to test when monotonic retention is not independently trustworthy

source_basis: Current connected GitHub contents-API capability contract exposes create-new-path semantics, replacement only with current blob SHA, and exact path fetch/readback; no protected/admin branch-retention mechanism is assumed.
tested_scope: One bounded CLEAN architecture/information-flow falsification using frozen current controls, own r268 LATEST state, and current GitHub connector capability contracts only. No O/downstream/other-worker semantics, protected authority, hosted compute/storage add-ons, external model/API execution, finite monthly/trial/paid quota consumption, manual execution, scheduler mutation, same-run wait/poll/backoff/retry, or optional second leaf.
frontier: r268's Omega(K) system-wide terminal-information lower bound remains unchanged.
Concurrent same-effect writers do not require a central lock if they share an authority-bound deterministic path and use create-only plus exact readback semantics.
Authority drift must be part of the deterministic key; otherwise stale-authority terminal records can collide with current work.
The decisive unresolved condition is monotonic terminal-record retention on the authoritative ref; without it, current-path 404 cannot prove absence after rewrite/deletion.
exact_continuation: Fresh-bootstrap current controls and reconstruct r269 from LATEST. Execute exactly one bounded CLEAN Phase-1 child: test whether an O(1)-active-state hash-chain/retained-anchor scheme can mechanically detect authoritative-ref rewrite or terminal deletion without branch-protection/admin authority, finite quota, hosted compute, or a shared rolling CAS hotspot. Model one retained predecessor digest, one rewrite that removes a terminal path, and one later recurrence; distinguish detection from prevention and determine whether exact duplicate/no-silent-loss safety can be recovered or remains conditional on repository retention.
